citations.quote: the inverse of the negative skew seen in the equity market

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Equity-market implied volatility exhibits a negative skew: downside (low-strike) options carry higher implied volatility than upside strikes, the inverse of the positive skew seen in volatility-of-volatility products. Skew is why out-of-the-money puts are relatively expensive to buy and lucrative to sell.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Equity Volatility Skew Is Negative: Downside Strikes Richer
